note: MISMATCH: Filename says Alabdulla 2019 about humic acid, but actual paper is Al-Freeh et al. 2019 (Basrah J. Agric. Sci. 32(Spec Issue):8-25) about microbial biofertilizers (Azotobacter, Pseudomonas, Bacillus) + mineral fertilizer on oat. These are microbial inoculants, NOT biostimulants (SWE/HFA/PHs/chitosan). Does not fit Li 2022 biostimulant meta-analysis scope.
title: Effect of Mineral-Biofertilizer on Physiological Parameters and Yield of Three Varieties of Oat (Avena sativa L.)
authors: Al-Freeh LM, Alabdulla SA, Huthily KH
exclusion_reason: Treatments are microbial biofertilizers (Azotobacter chroococcum, Pseudomonas putida, Pantoea agglomerans, Bacillus subtilis, Bacillus mucilaginosus) combined with NPK mineral fertilizers. Not biostimulants per Li 2022 definition.
